div.div:
Truststore
CAs Apigee trusts. Verifies the backend's certificate (Enabled=true, optional CommonName check).

div.div:
Keystore (mTLS only)
Apigee's own certificate + key, presented when the backend sets ClientAuthEnabled=true. The backend verifies Apigee.

div.div:
Rule of thumb
Always verify the backend cert. Add mTLS when the backend can enforce it.
Never disable verification to "make it work".
